parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of an instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The mode of the instance. Valid values:

*   `instance`: reserved storage mode
*   `ALIYUN::GPDB::INSTANCE`: elastic storage mode

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of a tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter value cannot be an empty string. A tag key can contain a maximum of 128 characters. It cannot start with `aliyun` or`  acs: ` and cannot contain `http://` or`  https:// `.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of a tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter value can be an empty string. A tag value can contain a maximum of 128 characters. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
